coordinate_system: Full unmodified card, origin upper left, x right and y down. LEFT stereo exposure only. No crop, resample, rectification, or coordinates from the right exposure are used.
method: Uncertainty-weighted nonlinear pinhole fit to 13 hand-read architectural points, with five held-out upper sills. Fixed eye height 2m, pixel aspect 1, zero skew. Fit minimizes source-coordinate error against the current reconstructed model. It cannot independently resolve absolute historical height or the basement/street datum.

limits: Only one stereo half is fitted. Stereo baseline and optical calibration are unknown; no stereo triangulation is claimed.
Digitized card may contain mounting/scan distortion; no anisotropic scaling is assumed without an independent measurement.
13 fit points are observations of one image, not 13 independent archival dimensions.
Current shell height, upper opening levels, fixed camera eye height and grade all remain reconstruction assumptions.
Two grade observations remain partly obscured and carry reduced weight. Cornice/roof projections are approximated by the shell coordinates.
No model render or accepted image comparison is generated by this helper.
